record_id.description: Stable UUID; retain through renames and changes in capacity.

name.description: Identifiable facility, phase or exact equipment name.

capacity_scope.description: Physical boundary and configuration covered by reported ratings.

notes.description: Review notes; no unsupported technical facts.

address.description: Public postal address; no access instructions.

location_accuracy.description: Precision and method of public coordinates.

campus_id.description: Stable grouping identifier; not itself a capacity claim.

facility_id.description: Stable facility identifier, shared by phases of one facility.

parent_record_id.description: Optional parent project UUID in this catalogue.

overlap_group.description: Stable group for overlapping capacity observations.

manufacturer.description: OEM, not distributor or integrator unless explicitly identified as manufacturer.

variant.description: Explicit documented configuration; never synthesized combinations.

product_status.description: Dated OEM lifecycle claim; availability is not assumed.

form_factor.description: Physical form factor and units where applicable.

power_rating_kind.description: TDP, board power, rated input or other explicit boundary.

power_conditions.description: Conditions and qualifier of electrical rating.

cooling_rating_conditions.description: Temperatures, approach, flow and qualifiers at the stated cooling rating.

efficiency_conditions.description: Load, topology, mode and boundary for efficiency.

status_date_basis.description: Publication date or dated retrieval of undated evidence.

aggregation_role.description: Only independent or child records can contribute to sums. Aggregate and unresolved scopes are excluded even if filtered children are absent.

status.description: Last evidenced project lifecycle; a portfolio listing alone does not establish operation.

quality_status.description: Evidence qualification; does not certify a facility or product.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp; updated_at changes only on substantive data/evidence changes.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp; updated_at changes only on substantive data/evidence changes.

last_verified_at.description: UTC timestamp; updated_at changes only on substantive data/evidence changes.

status_as_of.description: ISO date; only precise reported dates, never a forecast treated as achieved.

announcement_date.description: ISO date; only precise reported dates, never a forecast treated as achieved.

construction_date.description: ISO date; only precise reported dates, never a forecast treated as achieved.

commissioning_date.description: ISO date; only precise reported dates, never a forecast treated as achieved.

expansion_date.description: ISO date; only precise reported dates, never a forecast treated as achieved.

retirement_date.description: ISO date; only precise reported dates, never a forecast treated as achieved.

aliases.description: Explicit evidenced values; linked IDs refer to existing canonical records.

sources.description: Explicit evidenced values; linked IDs refer to existing canonical records.

source_urls.description: Explicit evidenced values; linked IDs refer to existing canonical records.

owner_names.description: Explicit evidenced values; linked IDs refer to existing canonical records.

operator_names.description: Explicit evidenced values; linked IDs refer to existing canonical records.

developer_names.description: Explicit evidenced values; linked IDs refer to existing canonical records.

tenant_names.description: Explicit evidenced values; linked IDs refer to existing canonical records.

contractor_names.description: Explicit evidenced values; linked IDs refer to existing canonical records.

supplier_names.description: Explicit evidenced values; linked IDs refer to existing canonical records.

equipment_record_ids.description: Explicit evidenced values; linked IDs refer to existing canonical records.

bess_project_record_ids.description: Explicit evidenced values; linked IDs refer to existing canonical records.

bess_equipment_record_ids.description: Explicit evidenced values; linked IDs refer to existing canonical records.

communication_protocols.description: Explicit evidenced values; linked IDs refer to existing canonical records.

field_sources_json.description: Map each populated factual column to registered source IDs. No wildcard evidence.

evidence_json.description: Field-level locator, units, publication date/revision and confidence; keys match field_sources_json.

entities_json.description: Stable entity IDs, disclosed names and precise owner/operator/developer/tenant roles.

observations_json.description: Bounded observations, each with field, value, unit, source_id, locator, boundary, as_of and kind. Use for PUE/WUE, dates, capacities, water, performance and investment.

renewable_supply_json.description: Separate physical_generation, contractual_procurement and environmental_claims objects; do not conflate.

certifications_json.description: Issuer, certificate, scope, date and source; marketing claims are not verified certificates.

estimates_json.description: Derived estimates with method and uncertainty, never substituted into reported columns.

conflicts_json.description: Quarantined field observations and source dates/boundaries; unresolved numeric fields must be null.

extensions_json.description: Extra documented metadata with units and conditions.

it_capacity_mw.description: Reported it capacity; requires basis. Never derived from another capacity.

grid_capacity_mw.description: Reported grid capacity; requires basis. Never derived from another capacity.

facility_capacity_mw.description: Reported facility capacity; requires basis. Never derived from another capacity.

it_under_construction_mw.description: Explicit IT capacity physically under construction.

it_ultimate_mw.description: Explicit total ultimate planned IT capacity; not additional capacity.

backup_generation_mw.description: Rated backup generator capacity, not IT or grid capacity.

battery_power_mw.description: Battery power at a stated boundary.

building_area_m2.description: Reported building area; not site or data-hall area.

data_hall_area_m2.description: Reported server/data-floor area; explicit unit conversion may be recorded.

rack_power_kw.description: Reported rack rating, never a facility capacity estimate.

connection_voltage_kv.description: Publicly reported nominal grid supply voltage.

input_power_kw.description: Server/equipment input power; not accelerator TDP.

apparent_power_kva.description: Rated apparent output power; not inferred active kW.

accelerator_power_w.description: Accelerator TDP/TBP or limit; rating kind and conditions required.

efficiency_pct.description: Reported efficiency with load and mode.

thermal_output_kw.description: Reported thermal output, not inferred from electrical input.

liquid_flow_l_min.description: Reported liquid flow at stated rating.

memory_gb.description: Reported memory capacity; preserve OEM GB/GiB basis in evidence.

runtime_minutes.description: Runtime at runtime_load_kw with configuration and battery conditions.

rack_count.description: Explicit reported count for this physical boundary.

accelerator_count.description: Explicit reported count for this physical boundary.

latitude.description: Public source coordinate; no inferred centroids.

longitude.description: Public source coordinate; no inferred centroids.

liquid_cooling_ready.description: Explicit technical readiness; not verified installed GPUs or deployed liquid cooling.

technical_area_m2.description: Operator-reported technical space; not assumed identical to building or data-hall area.
